title: Impact-AI Hackathon — Winner 🏆
description: Won 1st Place at Impact-AI-Thon '26, a 48-hour hackathon at St. Joseph's College of Engineering, Chennai. Competed as Team ThinkInBetween from VIT Vellore, winning ₹40,000 cash prize in the AI/ML category.

title: 2nd Prize — ₹50,000 | MEGATHON’26
description: Secured 2nd Prize with a cash award of ₹50,000 at MEGATHON’26, hosted by Saveetha Engineering College, Chennai, for developing Drestein — an innovative solution showcasing technical excellence, creativity, and real-world problem-solving.

title: 2nd Place — Auto Expo 2026 | ARC, VIT
description: Secured 2nd Place with a ₹10,000 cash prize in the Mobility Mastermind (AI Embedded Automotive Systems) track at Auto Expo 2026, hosted by the Automotive Research Centre (ARC), Vellore Institute of Technology.

title: 3rd Place — $150 | Panimalar Engineering College
description: Secured 3rd Place and won $150 in the Best Track at Panimalar Engineering College for developing Journey360 — an AI-powered, context-aware travel companion that integrates intelligent itinerary planning, real-time safety alerts, navigation, weather updates, and adaptive travel recommendations. Implemented ActionVector DB to enhance intelligent action planning and decision-making, helping travelers adapt to changing conditions and make safer, smarter, and more informed travel decisions.

title: Top 10 All India — SanDisk Cerebrum Hackathon
description: Ranked among the Top 10 teams across India in the SanDisk Cerebrum Hackathon for developing SanDisk Cerebrum — an AI-powered die yield intelligence system that detects whether semiconductor wafer dies pass or fail. Built a multimodal AI pipeline combining electrical measurements, spatial features, and CNN-based raw signal analysis to identify potential defects, improve detection precision, and reduce unnecessary secondary analysis through an intelligent cascade architecture.

title: Special Mention & 5th Prize — SRCAS, Coimbatore
description: Recognized with a Special Mention and secured 5th Prize at Sri Ramakrishna College of Arts & Science (SRCAS), Coimbatore, for developing GramOne — a rural problem-to-impact platform connecting citizens, Panchayat governance, IoT-based infrastructure monitoring, and CSR funding to improve rural communities.

title: Cyberverse Hackathon — Runner-Up
description: Secured Runner-Up position at Cyberverse, a 36-hour hackathon at Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore. Built CyberShield — an AI-powered system for detecting spam offers and phishing attempts.

title: LeetCode Problem Solver
description: Solved 50+ problems on LeetCode, strengthening problem-solving and DSA skills across arrays, graphs, trees, and dynamic programming.

title: AWS Cloud Technical Certificate
description: Earned AWS Cloud Technical Essentials certification, demonstrating proficiency in cloud architecture and deployment.

title: Google Project Management Certificate
description: Completed Google's Project Management professional certificate, mastering Agile methodologies, stakeholder management, and project lifecycle.

title: Merit Rank Holder — VIT
description: Achieved merit rank in the first year at Vellore Institute of Technology with a 9.44 CGPA in Integrated MTech CSE.
